lastRequest: Build a modern AI-powered Personal Study Assistant that helps students study smarter. It should allow users to upload PDFs, DOCX, PPTs, images, and handwritten notes, chat with uploaded study materials, summarize chapters, explain concepts at different difficulty levels, generate quizzes and flashcards, create personalized study plans, track progress, solve doubts with AI, generate mock tests, analyze diagrams, provide interview preparation, support voice input and text-to-speech, maintain study history, and offer a beautiful responsive dashboard with dark/light mode. Use React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, JWT authentication, vector search for document retrieval, AI provider abstraction (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, Anthropic), Docker, REST API, testing, documentation, and a production-ready architecture.

tasks.title: Database Schema & Vector Setup
tasks.description: Initialize Prisma configuration with PostgreSQL and pgvector extension, define User, Document, DocumentChunk, Flashcard, Quiz, StudyPlan, and StudyTask models.

tasks.title: Backend Authentication & Document Ingestion API
tasks.description: Implement JWT authentication middleware and multi-format document ingestion pipeline with multer, pdf-parse, mammoth, tesseract.js, chunking, and vector embedding generation.

tasks.title: RAG Chat, Flashcards & Study Plan Engines
tasks.description: Develop backend services for pgvector similarity search, RAG chat completion with LangChain, automated flashcard/quiz generation, and adaptive study plan scheduling.

tasks.title: Frontend Core Layout, Auth & Dashboard
tasks.description: Build React and Tailwind CSS application layout, authentication views, interactive dashboard with Recharts analytics, and study plan progress tracking.

tasks.title: Frontend RAG Chat, Flashcards & Voice Interaction
tasks.description: Implement interactive RAG chat interface, flashcard study decks with framer-motion and canvas-confetti, quiz modules, and Web Speech API voice interaction components.
